```yaml
name: Release Binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - '[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Setup repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Deno
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2
        with:
          deno-version: v2.x

      - name: Compile binaries
        run: |
          deno compile \
            --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc \
            --output invidious_companion-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe \
            --allow-import=github.com:443,jsr.io:443,cdn.jsdelivr.net:443,esm.sh:443,deno.land:443 \
            --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read --allow-sys=hostname --allow-write=/var/tmp/youtubei.js,/tmp/invidious-companion.sock \
            src/main.ts \
            --_version_date="$(git log -1 --format=%ci | awk '{print $1}' | sed s/-/./g)" \
            --_version_commit="$(git rev-list HEAD --max-count=1 --abbrev-commit)"

          deno compile \
            --target x86_64-apple-darwin \
            --output invidious_companion-x86_64-apple-darwin \
            --allow-import=github.com:443,jsr.io:443,cdn.jsdelivr.net:443,esm.sh:443,deno.land:443 \
            --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read --allow-sys=hostname --allow-write=/var/tmp/youtubei.js,/tmp/invidious-companion.sock \
            src/main.ts \
            --_version_date="$(git log -1 --format=%ci | awk '{print $1}' | sed s/-/./g)" \
            --_version_commit="$(git rev-list HEAD --max-count=1 --abbrev-commit)"

          deno compile \
            --target aarch64-apple-darwin \
            --output invidious_companion-aarch64-apple-darwin \
            --allow-import=github.com:443,jsr.io:443,cdn.jsdelivr.net:443,esm.sh:443,deno.land:443 \
            --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read --allow-sys=hostname --allow-write=/var/tmp/youtubei.js,/tmp/invidious-companion.sock \
            src/main.ts \
            --_version_date="$(git log -1 --format=%ci | awk '{print $1}' | sed s/-/./g)" \
            --_version_commit="$(git rev-list HEAD --max-count=1 --abbrev-commit)"

          deno compile \
            --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            --output invidious_companion-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            --allow-import=github.com:443,jsr.io:443,cdn.jsdelivr.net:443,esm.sh:443,deno.land:443 \
            --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read --allow-sys=hostname --allow-write=/var/tmp/youtubei.js,/tmp/invidious-companion.sock \
            src/main.ts \
            --_version_date="$(git log -1 --format=%ci | awk '{print $1}' | sed s/-/./g)" \
            --_version_commit="$(git rev-list HEAD --max-count=1 --abbrev-commit)"

          deno compile \
            --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            --output invidious_companion-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            --allow-import=github.com:443,jsr.io:443,cdn.jsdelivr.net:443,esm.sh:443,deno.land:443 \
            --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read --allow-sys=hostname --allow-write=/var/tmp/youtubei.js,/tmp/invidious-companion.sock \
            src/main.ts \
            --_version_date="$(git log -1 --format=%ci | awk '{print $1}' | sed s/-/./g)" \
            --_version_commit="$(git rev-list HEAD --max-count=1 --abbrev-commit)"

      - name: Create Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload Windows Binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./invidious_companion-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe
          asset_name: invidious_companion-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

      - name: Upload macOS x86_64 Binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./invidious_companion-x86_64-apple-darwin
          asset_name: invidious_companion-x86_64-apple-darwin
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

      - name: Upload macOS ARM64 Binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./invidious_companion-aarch64-apple-darwin
          asset_name: invidious_companion-aarch64-apple-darwin
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

      - name: Upload Linux x86_64 Binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./invidious_companion-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          asset_name: invidious_companion-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

      - name: Upload Linux ARM64 Binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./invidious_companion-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          asset_name: invidious_companion-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream
```
